channel.description: Daily updates on open-source automated research tools: commits, releases, and community activity.

item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-04
item.description:
Our community has been buzzing with activity across multiple projects. Notably, the `scienceverse/metacheck` project saw an update to its `data_check` branch, introducing dedicated import and export functionality for files. Meanwhile, `giladfeldman/docpluck` made significant progress with updates to its documentation and fixes for tables and harness issues, as well as a new release for the "glyph" component. The `Davidvandijcke/coarse` project also made strides, with additions such as "Buy Me a Coffee" funding links and a security fix to harden release audit and workflows. Additionally, `JamieCummins/regcheck` addressed several issues, including a CLI bug and ad blocker interference, highlighting the community's commitment to refining and improving our tools. These updates demonstrate the connections and collaborations within our community, driving progress and innovation across our open-source research projects.

43 commits across 7 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.1

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

item.title: docpluck: 12 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Work was done on the `main` branch, where the documentation was updated to reflect that "run-4 session close — v2.4.119 shipped; RC-T cycles 4-6 + gold-queue handoffs" and also to note that "run-4 close — W0n shipped (v2.4.118); maier η²p adjudicated OCR-tier; punch-list current". A fix was implemented for tables, specifically to address the issue where "tables no longer drop their first rows (v2.4.119)". Additionally, another fix was made to the harness, changing it to "skip only when the prior extraction matches the RUNNING library version (R-0004)". The `docpluck-review` feature was also updated to include an "universal-quantifier spot-check hard rule". Furthermore, a release was made for the "glyph" component, which included "W0n p-threshold dropped-decimal recovery — v2.4.118".

12 commit(s) today:

  • adb52b0 [main] docs(handoff): run-4 session close — v2.4.119 shipped; RC-T cycles 4-6 + gold-queue handoffs — Gilad Feldman
  • 89fc6d5 [main] fix(tables): RC-T caption-tail walk — tables no longer drop their first rows (v2.4.119) — Gilad Feldman
  • b5382ac [main] docs(todo): close R-0072 as verified false transfer — Gilad Feldman
  • 9985519 [main] fix(harness): skip only when the prior extraction matches the RUNNING library version (R-0004) — Gilad Feldman
  • 4daea57 [main] docpluck-review: add universal-quantifier spot-check hard rule — Gilad Feldman
  • d769554 [main] docs(triage+handoff): run-4 close — W0n shipped (v2.4.118); maier η²p adjudicated OCR-tier; punch-list current — Gilad Feldman
  • e7d7e47 [main] release(glyph): W0n p-threshold dropped-decimal recovery — v2.4.118 — Gilad Feldman
